why: The source of the MAME 0.285 binary used as a detector: the genesis/megadriv/megadrij drivers (sega/megadriv.cpp, mdconsole.cpp), the VDP (video/315_5313.cpp, which embeds the 315-5124 for Mode 4), YM2612 via ymfm, the SN76496, the cartridge slot and pads.
Eke's emulator, whose comments record many hardware measurements (VDP timing, DMA, FIFO, YM2612). Non-commercial licence: read and cite, never copy.

The YM3438 (CMOS OPN2) emulated from its die shot, with a YM2612 mode ('MD1, MD2 VA2': the DAC's ladder distortion) and a read mode: the judge for the FM unit. LGPL-2.1: read and compare against, never copy.
The PSG inside the YM7101 VDP emulated from the die (the Mega Drive's SN76489-compatible PSG): a judge for the PSG that sms-python never had. GPL-2.0: read and compare against, never copy.
The whole chipset emulated from decapped silicon (FC1004: YM7101 VDP with PSG, arbiter, I/O, TMSS, FM, NMOS 68000 and Z80): the strongest detector there is. GPL-2.0: read, never copy.
The gate-level reverse engineering behind Nuked-MD: VDP, arbiter, I/O chip, FM netlists and notes (CC0-1.0). The die photographs are left out.
Low-level die-derived models including the NMOS YM2612 (fmopna_2612.c), which Nuked-OPN2 (YM3438) is not. GPL-2.0: read, never copy.
Nemesis's emulator, built alongside his logic-analyser work; 121/122 on his own VDPFIFOTesting (2013). MIT; the no-copy rule still applies.
BlastEm (libretro's git mirror; upstream is Mercurial at retrodev.com): the best published VDP evidence among maintained emulators (Overdrive 2, VDPFIFOTesting). GPL-3.0: read, never copy.
Claims VDPFIFOTesting, Direct Color DMA and MD Soft Checker in its release notes. GPL-3.0: read, never copy.
Accuracy-minded, explicitly incomplete. AGPL-3.0: read, never copy.
The 240p Test Suite's Genesis source (GPL-2.0), which also generates the MDFourier signal the hardware recordings captured.
The analyser that compares a recording of the MDFourier signal with a reference (no licence stated: read only).
A disassembly of the TMSS boot ROM that rebuilds bit-exact (no licence stated: read only).
